'''Lox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Freliq]]. He worked for manager [[Yasil Senerio]] for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and was one of the few to witness the rescuing of Yasil's daughter [[Jullisa Senerio|Jullisa]].<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy" />
